notes.title: January 6th Full Release Update
notes.content:
Our game is now fully released. We truly appreciate your patience and continued support as we worked on these developments.

This update is a significant one, introducing a variety of new systems and enhancements to the game. While it doesn't include new game content, it focuses on essential systemic improvements.

Updates:
-The issue of the ball disappearing in "Nippon Goal" has been fixed.
-The storm that alters the direction of the balls in "Nippon Goal" has been improved. It now has a greater impact on the game.
-The issue in "Cliff Arena" where spears couldn't be thrown according to the player's inputs has been resolved.
-Issues with camera movements at the end of matches have been fixed.
-The issue of being unable to exit the credits screen using a gamepad has been fixed.
-In-game UIs have been improved.
-Text issues in multiplayer mode have been fixed.
-The mouse controller added for navigating menus has been improved.
-Player and AI issues in multiplayer mode have been resolved.
-AIs have been improved and optimized to provide a better gaming experience for players.
-A system has been added to speed up the remaining AIs when all players are defeated.
-The game maps have been restructured and optimized for a better gaming experience.
-The game's color and lighting palette has been changed and improved.
-Objects found in many maps have been improved and visually enhanced.
-Words and sentences that didn't change when the language was switched have been fixed.
-Many incorrect translations in the localizations have been professionally corrected.
-A comprehensive "Settings" menu has been developed, and previously non-functional settings have been fixed.
-The instructions in the "How to Play" menu, which guide players on how to play the games, have been improved and made more explanatory.
-After clicking the "Play Offline" or "Play Online" buttons, players were unsure of what to do on the "Customization" and "Split Screen Play" screens. Instructions and UIs have been added to guide players on what actions to take on these screens.

notes.title: BIG UPDATE PATCH 1.1
notes.content:
Thank you for your patience and support as we awaited these developments.

This update is a major one that adds many systems and enhancements to the game. It does not pertain to game content, but rather to systemic updates.

Updates:

-Mouse control has been added. Sections that can be controlled with the mouse include:
     Main Menu, How to Play, Settings, Credits, Character Customization, Lobby Menu, Map Selection Menu.
-Credits have been added.
-The settings menu has been improved and expanded.
-In Funball, a goal effect has been added when a goal is scored.
-In the Water Wrestle map, the winner of each round is announced on screen at the end of the round.
-In the lobby, the characters of added players will display their "Steam" names, making it clearer who is who.
-Indicators above characters have been improved.

Known issues and ongoing developments:

-In Nippon Goal, the ball can disappear, and scores may decrease due to unseen balls.
-At the end of each map, the character's victory animation and the names of the winners are not aligned.
-In Cliff Arena, if no directional input is given, the potato might not throw a spear in the direction it is facing.
-In Slide Fast, it can be difficult to discern who is who. We are working to make this clearer.
-If the leaderboard is not entered on the first visit, the initial 1000 points are not added. We are working on this issue.
-In Water Wrestle, the camera sometimes does not move to the correct position at the end of the game.

We are still in the development phase, so we thank you for your understanding. Please report any issues you encounter so we can address them. If there are features you would like to see added, you can reach us through our Discord server.

Cheers!!
